svg.desc: The game's four hulls (src/yard.js, Yard.hullProfile), 1 unit = 1 px, 1 unit = 4.6 cm. In the game the hull's frame is rotated to its heading and then squashed to 0.75 in y (the three-quarter camera); a texture mapped in this frame turns with the planks. The outline is drawn at scale (1, 1), the floor at (0.84, 0.62) of it; the strake lines at 0.95 and 0.9 of the half-width; the cells are 24 units along the keel and the rows a cell carries per side are marked above it.

g.title: Faering: 6.3 m by 1.4 m; 5 keel cells of 24 units; the bow at +x
g.text: Faering: 136 by 30 units (6.3 m by 1.4 m); 2 thwarts at 24 units' pitch; shields 20 units across, 11 apart
